name: Every screen meets WCAG 2.2 AA
says: the first visit, every place in the person's view, an opened item, Settings and an answer meet WCAG 2.2 at level AA, as axe-core 4.10.3 (pinned by SHA-256) checks it, at desktop and phone widths in light and dark, on the specifications' own examples
